notes.title: Update #12 - The end of nasty installations
notes.content:
Hellaz traders, producers and consumers!

And another important update!
You are no longer required to install Java to play the game. Yay!

Also, ingame, destroying some power producing buildings would always destroy all of them, no matter how many You actually planned to destroy. This is now no longer the case.

Have a great week, everyone and if there's something wrong: write me!
Cheerio!

notes.title: Update #11 - Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
Happy Anniversary traders, producers and consumers!

Finally (one day late, sorry) the anniversary update for Haprokon is here!
After already updating the store page and editing the achievement descriptions in Steam there are some important changes in the game.

Here the complete change list:

[b]changes:[/b]
- the pineapples are no longer as ugly as they were.

[b]achievement changes:[/b]
- all time-related achievements have been made much easier
- viewer completed quests are required to unlock the quest related achievements
- the achievement 'Always a smile on the face' is now much easier
- the power-related achievements are now much easier
- the no-quest-fail achievement is now easier to unlock

[b]important fixes[/b]
- destroying certain buildings no longer increases their productivity beyond 100%
- Your population will no longer consume wine which isn't there.
- changing the action multiplier (10x, 100x, 1000x) will now change all the important numbers when viewing the goods 'glass' and 'tarmac'
- wine production plants will now tell You, when grapes are missing
- rice liquor production plants will now properly consume power
- destroying lithium electrolysis laboratories will now now longer destroy salt lake shovellers

[b]smaller fixes:[/b]
- when exiting the bankruptcy-screen it will put you back to the main menu, not the options screen
- fixed some spelling mistakes

notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
What's up, traders, producers and consumers?

Here the update to version 1.0.3 bringing a fix to the game-freeze bug and some other new features and fixes. Looky here:

[b]Major features:[/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a x1000-button! Upon reaching the highest civilisation level You can now do things in 1000s-steps cutting Your clicking needs by at least a factor of ten!
[*] There are now more sound channels which means more bings upon reaching multiple challenge ranks and this should also fix the game-freeze bug. 
If the game freeze still happens to someone, tell me!
[/list]

[b]Minor fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] when in the consumption good overview of a category and You click on back it will now properly display the building costs when hovering over the build button.
[*] material consuming power plants now no longer talk about satisfaction but about progress instead
[*] when all phosphorite deposits are depleted it will now tell You so and not about "not enough null". Oops.
[*] sodium cyanide will now be capped to the maximum storage capacity.
[*] when Your per-minute-income and power get too high (or low) the numbers will now be abbreviated
[*] stone quarries will now display the correct maintenance costs
[*] sulphur mines will now tell You how much money they cost and not just about the fact THAT they cost money :P
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
Good evening, traders, producers and consumers!

Here are the patchnotes for update 1.0.1!

[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] - Added caps for challenges. This will now nicely be shown when You reach that cap.
[*] - When in the overview of a consumption-category (where You can for example see the list of all the fruits that make Your people happy) You can now click on the bars which will immediately make You jump to that corresponding good!
[/list]

[b]Minor changes and fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] - having too much many will no longer reset the game. Thank god!
[*] - when building a house for Your people of which there were 0 before it will now correctly show the satisfaction bars of these people.
[*] - a delivery quest will no longer require You to have x+1 in storage of the good to be delivered when the amount to be delivered is x.
[*] - the resource screen will now be updated when an expedition is finished and the resource screen is open
[*] - Electrolysis Laboratories will no longer require too much power
[*] - Electronics Factories will now consume power as shown.
[*] - The achievement 'population explosion' will now hopefully trigger correctly. Should You already have a game started and 500 people in Your city it will unfortunately give You this achievement now :(
[/list]

[b]Minor errors / typos:[/b]
[list]
[*] - Leather Factories will no longer ask for wool when leather is missing.
[*] - Ammonia Reactors will no properly ask for hydrogen, not water.
[/list]

[b]Known problems:[/b]
I am very aware of a problem that causes the game to simply stop time. Should that ever happen (seen, when the bars no longer move, no more money is earned and no goods are consumed anymore) simply quit and restart the game. 
I'm working on a fix for that and will upload as soon as possible!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Good Day, traders, producers and consumers!

It's been over two months since my last post and I guess it's time for a new one.

[h1]Production Clocks[/h1]

To further increas the clarity of what good is needed for what, You can now click on a question mark in the top right corner of a good's info screen:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34568875/20c5e683830b715d9688a0eb626b94540665d831.png[/img]

This will lead You to the Production Clock of that specific good which shows You, what exactly that good is needed for.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34568875/181e743b7023350f823b832db0f824535724a5ce.png[/img]

Should You click on the icons at the end of an arrow, it will lead You directly to the corresponding overview of that product.
And as the game progresses, the production clocks will be updated, too:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34568875/05cf73c3ed0a3bc8756ed65b8ca86472a049758e.png[/img]

That's all for today.
I hope the heat doesn't get to You ;)

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hello, traders, producers and consumers!

After happily seeing, that some of You are actually interested in this game (You crazy people!) I decided to let You know, how things are going.

In fact, many things are happening simultaneously right now. I'll keep You updated about all the progress.

Today I will write about the 

[h1]Game Settings[/h1]

Since making the game publicly visible on Steam I added eight more difficulty settings to the previously six existing ones so You can modify Your experience each time You start a new game.

In addition there is a little info text in the bottom right corner that further explains, what exactly those settings change.

Looky here:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34568875/0867a6ea2ff917e4119e81d1db8fb50ef9321981.png[/img]

I hope You all have a great day!
I'll write soon.
